devdoc.details: Orchestrates all user-facing actions.      - Does NOT hold ETH (all ETH goes to FundingVault).      - Delegates campaign data to CampaignManager.      - Delegates access control to AccessControl.      - Mints reward tokens via RewardToken. Function signatures must EXACTLY match STARTUPFUND_ABI in src/lib/contracts.ts.

claimRefund(uint256).details: Contributor claims a refund after campaign is CANCELLED.      - Contributor must have a non-zero contribution.

createCampaign(string,string,string,stri.details: Creates a new campaign. Only registered, unblocked users.      Signature matches STARTUPFUND_ABI exactly.

fundCampaign(uint256).details: Contributes ETH to a campaign.      - Campaign must be ACTIVE and before deadline.      - msg.value must be >= minContribution.      - On success, status is re-evaluated (may flip to FUNDED).      - If newly FUNDED, reward tokens are minted immediately.

tokenBalanceOf(address).details: Returns the RewardToken balance for a wallet.

totalCampaigns().details: Proxies to CampaignManager.campaignCount().      Named totalCampaigns() to match frontend ABI.

withdraw(uint256).details: Creator withdraws funds after campaign is FUNDED.      - Only callable once (fundsReleased flag in FundingVault).      - Reward tokens are minted first if not yet done.

documentation.text:
@title StartupFund
 @dev Orchestrates all user-facing actions.
      - Does NOT hold ETH (all ETH goes to FundingVault).
      - Delegates campaign data to CampaignManager.
      - Delegates access control to AccessControl.
      - Mints reward tokens via RewardToken.
 Function signatures must EXACTLY match STARTUPFUND_ABI in src/lib/contracts.ts.

@dev Creates a new campaign. Only registered, unblocked users.
      Signature matches STARTUPFUND_ABI exactly.

typeDescriptions.typeString: literal_string "StartupFund: creator cannot fund own campaign"

arguments.value: StartupFund: creator cannot fund own campaign

documentation.text:
@dev Contributes ETH to a campaign.
      - Campaign must be ACTIVE and before deadline.
      - msg.value must be >= minContribution.
      - On success, status is re-evaluated (may flip to FUNDED).
      - If newly FUNDED, reward tokens are minted immediately.

@dev Contributor claims a refund after campaign is CANCELLED.
      - Contributor must have a non-zero contribution.

@dev Proxies to CampaignManager.campaignCount().
      Named totalCampaigns() to match frontend ABI.
@dev Returns the RewardToken balance for a wallet.

@dev Reads minContribution from CampaignManager.
      CampaignManager exposes getCampaignStats which includes minContribution.
@dev Returns the total ETH held by FundingVault for a campaign.
